name: WARNING: Sushi Bar Spicy Tuna Crunch Roll (Sriracha, Chili Oil & Fried Tempura Flakes)
whyItWorks: Scrapings of minced tuna blended with Kewpie mayonnaise, Sriracha chili sauce, spicy sesame chili oil (Rayu), and topped with deep-fried batter bits (tenkasu). Capsaicin irritates ulcerations and speeds transit, while rancid fryer crunch scratches tissue.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Avoid all rolls labeled 'Spicy' or 'Crunchy'. Choose fresh salmon nigiri or avocado rolls with soy paper.
